name: safetyx2_prefx1_sky_x1
description: A safety-oriented preference dataset variant from the multilingual-reward-bench family that captures pairwise human preferences between model responses to assess safety alignment. It is intended for training/evaluating reward models and preference predictors to prefer safer, less harmful outputs across languages/variants.
reputation: Part of the multilingual-reward-bench suite; used in safety and alignment research but not a broadly standard benchmark outside that community.
